title: MARY Update Information - RC8
description: RC8 introduces native Windows application replacement using Squirrel.Windows while keeping MARYOS user data outside the installation directory.

sections.title: RC8 Native Windows Update
sections.body: When the official native feed is enabled, MARY Update reads the Squirrel.Windows RELEASES feed. A newer full application package is downloaded automatically and installed during restart.

sections.title: What is preserved?
sections.body: Virtual C:, user settings, installed MARY packages, custom MARYNET pages and cached online data remain in the stable MARYOS user profile outside the application install directory.

sections.title: Legacy Service Layer
sections.body: The older declarative .UPD system remains only as a compatibility fallback. RC8 retires obsolete RC7 service layers once the native base build is newer.
